_comment: Gemma 4's multi-token-prediction drafter (`Gemma4AssistantForCausalLM`, Google's `-it-assistant` repos). Unlike a Qwen3.5 head it ships as its own checkpoint with its own config, so it names its target config (`head_targets`: its stem -> `<arch>/<stem>`), and the target's facts it needs come from its `.overrides.json`: the target's layer count (its KV pool's geometry) and the target layers whose KV it reads. It has NO K/V of its own (`num_kv_shared_layers` = all its layers): its attention reads the target's KV of the target's last sliding and last full layer (`reads_target_kv`). It borrows only its target's embedding (`borrows`), placed under `target_embed_tokens`; its logits are its own tied 262k x 1024 embedding's, read as the `lm_head` linear straight from `model.embed_tokens` (renamed: the drafter never reads its embedding as one). `pre_projection` / `post_projection` sit at the checkpoint's top level (`top_level_weights`). mlx sets the attention `scale = 1.0` for both classes, as the target's. Rope scalars are nested per class under `rope_parameters`, aliased to the flat names as the target's.
